I understand how frustrating repeated follow-ups must be—I'm sorry you haven't gotten resolution yet.

I don't have access to your order history or refund status, so I can't see what's happened with your claim. **I need to escalate this to a Support Lead right away** so they can locate your case, investigate the delay, and get it sorted. They'll contact you at rvshankar45@gmail.com.

On international shipping: **our policy doesn't cover Canada or international orders** — we ship within the regions specified on our website. I'd recommend checking the shipping destinations listed at checkout, or I can escalate to ask if there are any exceptions available.

Which would help most: getting your refund escalated now, or information about international options?
